panels.title: User journey availability
panels.description: Purpose: API SLO and error-budget decision. Unit: ratio. Range: 6h. Interpret below 0.999 as budget consumption. Alerts: ApiFastErrorBudgetBurn, ApiSlowErrorBudgetBurn. Runbook: runbooks/api-slo.md

panels.title: Error budget remaining
panels.description: Purpose: release/incident decision. Unit: percent. Range: 30d. Interpret negative as exhausted. Alert: burn-rate alerts. Runbook: runbooks/api-slo.md

panels.title: API latency p95
panels.description: Purpose: identify user-visible API slowness. Unit: seconds. Range: 6h. Interpret above 1s as degraded. Alert: ApiLatencyHigh. Runbook: runbooks/api-slo.md

panels.title: Queue and workers
panels.description: Purpose: decide whether to restore/scale workers. Unit: jobs. Range: 6h. Growing wait means throughput deficit. Alerts: WorkerFleetUnavailable, QueueBacklog, OldestJobAgeHigh. Runbook: runbooks/worker-queue.md

panels.title: Deployment pipeline stages
panels.description: Purpose: locate slow/failing stages. Unit: seconds. Range: 6h. Compare p95 by stage/result. Alert: DeploymentFailureIncrease. Runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: Build capacity
panels.description: Purpose: decide build-worker scaling. Unit: builds. Range: 6h. Queued growth with active at limit means exhaustion. Alert: BuildCapacityExhausted. Runbook: runbooks/worker-queue.md

panels.title: Kubernetes operations
panels.description: Purpose: distinguish target-provider failures. Unit: seconds. Range: 6h. High failure count or latency blocks rollout. Alert: KubernetesProviderFailure. Runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: External providers
panels.description: Purpose: identify Git/registry/DNS/certificate/secret dependency degradation. Unit: seconds. Range: 6h. Alerts: RegistryFailure, GitWebhookFailure. Runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: PostgreSQL and Redis
panels.description: Purpose: decide data-service escalation. Unit: seconds/connections. Range: 6h. Alerts: DatabaseUnavailable, DatabasePoolExhausted, RedisFailure. Runbook: runbooks/data-services.md

panels.title: Live log streams
panels.description: Purpose: detect stale/disconnected user streams. Unit: connections/seconds. Range: 6h. Alert: LogStreamDegraded. Runbook: runbooks/live-observability.md

panels.title: Previews and certificates
panels.description: Purpose: cleanup and TLS risk decisions. Unit: resources/seconds. Range: 24h. Alerts: PreviewCleanupBacklog, CertificateExpiryRisk. Runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: Rollbacks
panels.description: Purpose: verify rollback success and duration. Unit: operations/seconds. Range: 24h. Alert: DeploymentFailureIncrease. Runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: Approvals and policies
panels.description: Purpose: find governance delay or denial changes. Unit: seconds/decisions. Range: 24h. Interpret prolonged waits by action and policy result changes. Related runbook: runbooks/deployment-providers.md

panels.title: Audit integrity
panels.description: Purpose: security escalation decision. Unit: failures. Range: 24h. Any value above zero is critical. Alert: AuditIntegrityFailure. Runbook: runbooks/audit-integrity.md

panels.title: Telemetry pipeline health
panels.description: Purpose: determine observability degradation without coupling product availability. Unit: failures/drops/ratio. Range: 6h. Alerts: TelemetryExportFailure, TelemetryDropsHigh. Runbook: runbooks/telemetry-pipeline.md

panels.title: Backup, restore and DR
panels.description: Purpose: decide whether recovery evidence meets RPO/RTO. Unit: seconds/failures. Range: 30d. Alerts: BackupFailure, BackupAgeExcessive, RestoreTestFailure, RestoreTestAgeExcessive, DrVerificationFailure. Runbook: DISASTER_RECOVERY_RUNBOOK.md
